LanguageData.YaOpt.Message.ErrorWhilePatching: YaOpt encountered an error while applying settings. The game may not function correctly. Check the console for details.
LanguageData.YaOpt.Setting.Message.RequireReload: Changed settings will take effect after loading a save or restarting the game.
LanguageData.YaOpt.Setting.Option.DebugOutput.Desc: Output debug info to the console. Enabling this may slightly reduce game speed, as the game records the entire stack trace for each console message, which is an expensive operation.
LanguageData.YaOpt.Setting.Option.LazyTextureLoad.Dds: Only enable lazy loading for DDS textures (and Zstd compressed DDS from ImageOpt). Non-DDS formats require extra time to convert to a renderable format upon loading, causing noticeable stuttering during runtime loading.
LanguageData.YaOpt.Setting.Option.MapMeshUpdateThrott: Adjusts the minimum real-time interval between two updates. Note that since the game uses incremental updates for terrain, this option has diminishing returns. Setting the interval to 1000ms won't reduce update overhead to 1/10th of 100ms, because the number of cells to process per update increases. Recommended values are 300 or 500. If you don't care about visual lag, 1000 is also acceptable.
